query: UPDATE import_run SET reported_stage = $5, discovered = GREATEST(discovered, $6), processed = GREATEST(processed, $7), last_contact_at = now(), last_progress_at = CASE WHEN $6 > discovered OR $7 > processed THEN now() ELSE last_progress_at END, reason_code = COALESCE($8, reason_code), reason = CASE WHEN $8 IS NULL THEN reason ELSE $9 END, state = CASE WHEN $10 THEN 'failed' ELSE state END, settled_at = CASE WHEN $10 THEN now() ELSE settled_at END, failure_detail = CASE WHEN $10 THEN $9 ELSE failure_detail END, lease_expires_at = CASE WHEN $10 THEN NULL ELSE now() + make_interval(secs => $11) END WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND owner_device = $3 AND attempt = $4 AND state IN ('reading', 'reviewing', 'committing') AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at > now() RETURNING state
